svg.title: Stage-3 predicted respiration, task T3: 4 representative subjects
svg.desc: Stacked panels, one subject each. The assembled Stage-3 prediction is drawn over the reference respiration waveform; both are z-scored over the displayed window, so only shape and phase are comparable, not amplitude.
svg.text: Stage-3 predicted respiration, task T3 · 4 representative subjects
BP4D+ · 5-fold CV (subject-disjoint) · Hann overlap-add of the per-clip predictions
band 0.1–0.6 Hz · both signals z-scored per panel: shape and phase only, not amplitude
Subjects ranked by their T3 band-limited Pearson and drawn at fixed quantiles: a strong, a typical, a weak and a poor subject.
Generated by code/notes/eval/tir_resp/plot_task_waveforms.py from the fold dumps; scored metrics in resp_5fold_cv.md.
